notes: Three matched arms baseline, motion and reference warm start the same source online weights with fresh AdamW and FP32 EMA.
Future camera and point trajectories are explicit pseudo-control inputs, not autonomous future prediction or semantic instance masks.
Appearance reference uses only observed frames; no future RGB or future texture is a condition.
Raw teacher labels align to the source cached frame_indices; preview videos are never training annotation sources.
The deterministic pilot selects 4096 original street windows; zero train_windows requests all original windows.
hours=0 disables wall-clock stopping; compare equal-step snapshots separately from convergence endpoints.
The launcher smoke uses separate namespaces and 24 train / 4 eval windows, three total updates and four sampler steps.
